name: Narodna skupština (National Assembly)
notes: Seats by electoral list as the Republic Electoral Commission (RIK) announced them on 5 to 6 November 2026 after the early election of 25 October 2026 (votes repeated at 53 polling stations on 1 November). The 15th convocation has not met yet: members take their seats when the first sitting confirms the mandates, and RIK assigns each mandate to a named candidate within 10 days, so no sitting member is listed and no supporter is lit. The Student List is a list of independent candidates backed by several parties, not one party. RIK's own results page is a script-driven portal that returns no data to plain clients; the figures are from Radio Free Europe's report of the final results, which a second report (Biznis.rs) repeats.
